Definition: the right hand or side (leg, eye) of a person or other object (as the stronger and more dexterous); locally, the south
BiblicalUsage: 1) right, right hand, right side; 1a) right hand; 1b) right (of direction); 1c) south (the direction of the right hand when facing East)
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
